# kinematicTreeFloatingBaseTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [kinematicTreeFloatingBaseTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/kinematicTreeFloatingBaseTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  ObjectKinematicTree with a floating base (#1549): a free rigid body - ObjectRigidBody on the base node, with
#           the mass of the base - and a tree of two revolute links on it, the tip of the second link on a
#           CartesianSpringDamper to the ground, under gravity. The same system as redundant model of three rigid
#           bodies and two revolute joints; on a Lie group node, on Euler parameters and on Tait-Bryan angles, with
#           generalized-alpha, and the tree on the Lie group node also with RK44, the explicit Lie group integration.
#           The tip of the tree follows the redundant model to the error of the time integration. Run directly, the
#           SolutionViewer shows the tree with RK44.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-02
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn import cMath #the norm of the C++ code, the same bits on every platform
import exudyn.graphics as graphics

import numpy as np

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)

L = 0.4
inertias = [InertiaCuboid(1000, [0.3, 0.2, 0.1]), InertiaCuboid(500, [L, 0.06, 0.05]), InertiaCuboid(500, [L, 0.05, 0.04])]
gravity = [0, -9.81, 0]
q0 = [0.3, -0.4]        #the joint angles
q0_t = [1.5, -0.8]      #the joint velocities
offsets = [[0.15, 0.02, 0.01], [L, 0, 0]] #of link 0 in the base, of link 1 in link 0
omegaB = np.array([0.5, 1.2, -0.7]) #of the base
vB = np.array([0.2, 0.1, -0.3])
anchor = [0.8, -0.3, -0.4] #of the spring-damper on the ground

def Model(useTree, nodeType, solver, steps=1600, tEnd=0.4):
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    ground = mbs.CreateGround()
    base = mbs.CreateRigidBody(inertia=inertias[0], referencePosition=[0, 0, 0], initialVelocity=vB,
                               initialAngularVelocity=omegaB, gravity=gravity, nodeType=nodeType, returnDict=True)
    if useTree:
        nGeneric = mbs.AddNode(NodeGenericODE2(referenceCoordinates=[0, 0], initialCoordinates=q0, initialCoordinates_t=q0_t,
                                               numberOfODE2Coordinates=2))
        tree = mbs.AddObject(ObjectKinematicTree(nodeNumber=nGeneric, baseNodeNumber=base['nodeNumber'],
                             jointTypes=[exu.JointType.RevoluteZ, exu.JointType.RevoluteX], linkParents=[-1, 0],
                             jointTransformations=exu.Matrix3DList([np.eye(3)]*2),
                             jointOffsets=exu.Vector3DList([[0, 0, 0], offsets[1]]), baseOffset=offsets[0],
                             linkInertiasCOM=exu.Matrix3DList([inertias[1].InertiaCOM(), inertias[2].InertiaCOM()]),
                             linkCOMs=exu.Vector3DList([[L/2, 0, 0]]*2),
                             linkMasses=[inertias[1].Mass(), inertias[2].Mass()], gravity=gravity,
                             visualization=VObjectKinematicTree(graphicsDataList=[[graphics.Brick(centerPoint=[L/2, 0, 0], size=[L, 0.06, 0.05], color=graphics.color.steelblue)],
                                                                                  [graphics.Brick(centerPoint=[L/2, 0, 0], size=[L, 0.05, 0.04], color=graphics.color.orange)]])))
        tip = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerKinematicTreeRigid(objectNumber=tree, linkNumber=1, localHT=HTtranslate([L, 0, 0])))
    else:
        #the links as rigid bodies, their initial state from the kinematics of the tree
        R0 = RotationMatrixZ(q0[0])
        R1 = R0 @ RotationMatrixX(q0[1])
        p0 = np.array(offsets[0])
        p1 = p0 + R0 @ np.array(offsets[1])
        w0 = omegaB + q0_t[0]*np.array([0, 0, 1])
        w1 = w0 + q0_t[1]*(R1 @ np.array([1, 0, 0]))
        v0 = vB + np.cross(omegaB, p0)
        v1 = v0 + np.cross(w0, p1 - p0)
        bodies = []
        for (R, p, w, v) in [(R0, p0, w0, v0), (R1, p1, w1, v1)]:
            com = p + R @ np.array([L/2, 0, 0])
            bodies.append(mbs.CreateRigidBody(inertia=inertias[len(bodies) + 1], referencePosition=com, referenceRotationMatrix=R,
                                              initialVelocity=v + np.cross(w, com - p), initialAngularVelocity=w,
                                              gravity=gravity, nodeType=nodeType))
        mbs.CreateRevoluteJoint(itemNumbers=[base['bodyNumber'], bodies[0]], position=p0, axis=[0, 0, 1])
        mbs.CreateRevoluteJoint(itemNumbers=[bodies[0], bodies[1]], position=p1, axis=R1 @ [1, 0, 0])
        tip = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=bodies[1], localHT=HTtranslate([L/2, 0, 0])))
    mbs.AddObject(CartesianSpringDamper(markerNumbers=[mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=ground, localHT=HTtranslate(anchor))), tip],
                                        stiffness=[50]*3, damping=[0.5]*3))
    sensor = mbs.AddSensor(SensorMarker(markerNumber=tip, storeInternal=True, outputVariableType=exu.OutputVariableType.Position))
    mbs.Assemble()

    s = exu.SimulationSettings()
    s.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = steps
    s.timeIntegration.endTime = tEnd
    s.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
    s.timeIntegration.newton.relativeTolerance = 1e-12
    s.timeIntegration.newton.absoluteTolerance = 1e-14
    s.timeIntegration.newton.useModifiedNewton = False
    s.solution.file.write = not testIsActive and solver == exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44 #for the SolutionViewer
    mbs.SolveDynamic(s, solverType=solver, showHints=False)
    if not testIsActive and solver == exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44:
        mbs.SolutionViewer()
    return np.array(mbs.GetSensorValues(sensor))

testResult = 0
difference = 0.
for nodeType in [exu.NodeType.RotationRotationVector, exu.NodeType.RotationEulerParameters, exu.NodeType.RotationRxyz]:
    pTree = Model(True, nodeType, exu.DynamicSolverType.GeneralizedAlpha)
    pRedundant = Model(False, nodeType, exu.DynamicSolverType.GeneralizedAlpha)
    exu.Print(str(nodeType).split('.')[-1], ': the tip of the tree', pTree, ', the difference to the redundant model', cMath.norm(pTree - pRedundant))
    difference = max(difference, cMath.norm(pTree - pRedundant))
    testResult += sum(pTree)
pExplicit = Model(True, exu.NodeType.RotationRotationVector, exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44)
exu.Print('RK44 on the Lie group node: the tip', pExplicit)
testResult += sum(pExplicit)

testResult += int(difference > 1e-5) #the error of the time integration: 3e-6 at 1600 steps, 2e-7 at 6400
exu.Print('solution of kinematicTreeFloatingBaseTest=', testResult)
exu.sys['testResult'] = testResult
```
